brief: A 64x64 tile inspired by Mangalagiri handloom: 8-cell D4 body check in white on maroon, a 12-cell-tall bottom border of inverted gold checks (period 8) with a single centred dot between every pair of checks, mirrored onto the opposite edge to satisfy the host symmetry, exactly three colours, all marks on a 4x4 cell, border attached to the tile edge.
